rows.label: No public services charged
rows.what: Taxes, benefits and the gain from their work. No public service is charged.

rows.label: Taxes minus benefits
rows.what: Taxes paid against benefits received. No public services, no gain from their work.

rows.label: Private gain from their work only
rows.what: Others' gain in wages and profits. Every budget line is left out, even taxes on it.

rows.label: Main case as published September 20
rows.what: As published September 20: general administration not charged, data not yet corrected.

rows.label: Main case
rows.what: Schools add 63–66% of per-pupil cost, other services grow fully, administration 59–84%.

rows.label: All services at average cost
rows.what: Every public service grows one for one with the population.

rows.label: Everything at average cost
rows.what: A per-head share of everything, including defense and interest on debt already issued.
